steps.code:
# Now I will fetch all transactions sent by the user on Venmo from the first day of this month to today.
# I will paginate through all pages to get all transactions.
all_sent_transactions = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20  # max allowed per page

while True:
    response = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
        access_token=venmo_access_token,
        min_created_at=min_created_at,
        max_created_at=max_created_at,
        direction='sent',
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=page_limit
    )
    if not response:
        break
    all_sent_transactions.extend(response)
    if len(response) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print(len(all_sent_transactions))  # Number of transactions fetched this month so far.
